headline: Marketing Consulting | Local Growth | Performance Analytics
headline_rationale: Empower's role advises local business owners and marketing partners rather than directly running campaigns. The master supports multi-business PPC operating systems, client consulting, ROI and financial analysis, agency reviews and cross-functional business planning. This headline emphasizes those supported strengths without inventing formal franchise ownership or field-marketing tenure.
summary: Marketing advisor who turns campaign and financial data into practical growth decisions for business leaders. Supported a company group spanning 32 businesses with an in-house PPC operating system, team training and ERP integration, and advised clients across 75+ Google Ads accounts. Brings experience evaluating agency economics, forecasting investment outcomes, identifying funnel opportunities and coordinating with operations, finance, sales and web teams. Focuses on accountable recommendations that connect marketing spend with business performance.
factual_review: Read exact Empower posting and current master DOCX. Any Hour Services passages explicitly support the 32-business PPC operating system, team training and ERP integration. E010/E011/E063 support financial investment and agency analysis; E006 supports funnel opportunities; E060/E076/E078/E081/E096/E110 support cross-functional and client advisory work. E120 supports 75+ accounts. No unsupported franchise, Google Business Profile, Local Services Ads, travel commitment or residency claim is added.
tools_rationale: Master-supported measurement, dashboard, CRM and paid-media platforms relevant to interpreting local marketing/vendor performance and advising business owners. Unsupported platform-specific expertise is not inferred from the posting.
